purpose: Track curriculum/textbook mapping completeness for the MathBridge core baseline, distinguishing safe completed evidence states from optional future detail.

definitions.reference_complete: Every taxonomy concept resolves to relevant curriculum/framework evidence or an explicit framework non-placement/cross-cutting classification.
definitions.core_mapping_complete: The product can state the concept's China learning-stage/framework position, England position and Common Core baseline position without inventing equivalence.
definitions.pep_unit_sequence_complete: The revised PEP series has verified grade/semester/unit sequence across all 12 volumes.
definitions.below_unit_classified: Available subsection/lesson/page detail is stored at its evidence level; unavailable/later-rollout detail is explicitly classified rather than inferred.

classified_nonblocking_limits: Exact PEP subsection/page detail is not uniformly publicly available across all designed volumes; renderer uses only verified detail.
Exact single-page locators for every China 2022 bullet are not directly rendered; verified printed range + hierarchy is used.
PEP actual-use rollout varies by locality/publisher/term and is resolved as a query, not a national constant.
California/Texas are optional state overlays; Common Core remains the complete core US comparison baseline.
publication_rule: Core mapping is complete. Every rendered claim must still obey its evidence level; completion is not permission to upgrade secondary, unavailable or query-dependent fields.
